# Global Wind Atlas v4 — Layer Availability via the Per-Country API

*Generated by `scripts/probe_gwa_layers.py` on 2026-08-19 10:53 UTC. Do not edit by hand.*

Endpoint probed: `https://globalwindatlas.info/api/gis/country/AUS/<variable>[/<height>]`
Sizes are for full Australian coverage. HEAD requests only — no raster data transferred.

## Variables published at multiple heights

| Variable | Units | Heights available (m) | Australia file size | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `wind-speed` | m/s | 10, 50, 100, 150, 200 | 599–684 MB | 10-year mean wind speed |
| `power-density` | W/m^2 | 10, 50, 100, 150, 200 | 640–714 MB | 10-year mean wind power density |
| `air-density` | kg/m^3 | 10, 50, 100, 150, 200 | 287 MB | Modelled air density |
| `combined-Weibull-A` | m/s | 10, 50, 100, 150, 200 | 595–677 MB | All-sector Weibull scale parameter |
| `combined-Weibull-k` | - | 10, 50, 100, 150, 200 | 551–629 MB | All-sector Weibull shape parameter |

## Variables published without a height parameter

| Variable | Units | Available? | Australia file size | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `capacity-factor_IEC1` | ratio | Yes | 657 MB | IEC class 1 turbine, 100 m hub, 117 m rotor |
| `capacity-factor_IEC2` | ratio | Yes | 652 MB | IEC class 2 turbine, 100 m hub, 136 m rotor |
| `capacity-factor_IEC3` | ratio | Yes | 652 MB | IEC class 3 turbine, 100 m hub, 150 m rotor |
| `capacity-factor_offshore` | ratio | **No — HTTP 403** | — | Offshore turbine, 150 m hub, 150 m rotor |
| `RIX` | % | **No — HTTP 403** | — | Ruggedness index — area within 3.5 km with slopes over 30 degrees |
| `elevation` | m | **No — HTTP 403** | — | Site elevation used by the Atlas |

## Notes

- **Unavailable through this route:** `capacity-factor_offshore`, `RIX`, `elevation`. These exist in GWA 4 only as global rasters on the DTU repository (RIX 6.1 GB, site elevation 8.9 GB), or through the web application's interactive area download, which is not scriptable.
- No seasonal or monthly breakdown is published for any layer. Every layer is a single long-term mean over 2008–2017.
- The five layers sampled by this task total **3.16 GB** at full Australian coverage. Windowed `/vsicurl/` reads retrieved about 11 MB of that.
